rules_check_time_validity_when_work_repo.LABEL: Check time validity when Work report is saved

drupal_message.message: The number of hours you entered into work report caused the average number of hours worked since you created your account to exceed 24 hours a day ([wr-hours:value] h/day). As a consequence, the number of work hours was set to 0 in the work report.

The daily average number of hours (since you opened your account) is [wr-hours:value] hours per day, which might attract scrutiny from other NEO participants as being unrealistic. Please check that you have not mistakenly entered an incorrect value into the work report.
